name: copilot-ollama-router
description: Routes Copilot chat requests to a local Ollama model for cost-effective code generation while keeping Copilot for security review, architecture, and complex debugging.

chatParticipants.name: ollama
chatParticipants.description: Routes your request to a local Ollama model or Copilot based on task type.

commands.name: local
commands.description: Force delegation to local Ollama model

copilotOllamaRouter.endpoint.description: Base URL of the local Ollama API server.

copilotOllamaRouter.defaultModel.description: Default Ollama model for code-generation tasks.

copilotOllamaRouter.reasoningModel.description: Ollama model used for reasoning/documentation tasks.

enumDescriptions: Automatically classify and route each request.
copilotOllamaRouter.delegationMode.description: Controls when requests are sent to local Ollama vs Copilot cloud.

copilotOllamaRouter.copilotReviewEnabled.description: Run an optional Copilot quality-check pass on Ollama-generated output.

copilotOllamaRouter.requestTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time in milliseconds to wait for an Ollama streaming response.

copilotOllamaRouter.contextTokenBudget.description: Approximate token budget for editor context preamble. The router truncates context when this limit is exceeded (estimate: 1 token ≈ 4 chars).

copilotOllamaRouter.themisDbRules.description: Apply ThemisDB-specific routing rules: C++ codegen → Ollama local; security/architecture → Copilot cloud.

copilotOllamaRouter.routeBoilerplateToLo.description: Auto-route boilerplate/scaffolding prompts to local Ollama and prefill @ollama /local in chat entry commands.

copilotOllamaRouter.routeTestsToLocal.description: Auto-route test/spec/mock generation prompts to local Ollama and prefill @ollama /local in chat entry commands.

copilotOllamaRouter.routeRefactorsToLoca.description: Auto-route refactor/cleanup prompts to local Ollama and prefill @ollama /local in chat entry commands.

copilotOllamaRouter.routeDocsToLocal.description: Auto-route documentation prompts (README/JSDoc/Doxygen) to local Ollama and prefill @ollama /local in chat entry commands.

copilotOllamaRouter.routeCmakeToLocal.description: Auto-route CMake/build-system prompts to local Ollama and prefill @ollama /local in chat entry commands.

enumDescriptions: Log destination and reason for each routing decision.
Log full routing decision including prompt preview (first 80 chars).
copilotOllamaRouter.auditLogVerbosity.description: Controls verbosity of routing decisions logged to the 'Copilot Ollama Router' Output Channel.

copilotOllamaRouter.languageProfiles.description: Map of VS Code language ID to preferred Ollama model tag. Overrides the default model for that language. Built-in profiles: cpp/c/rust → deepseek-coder-v2:16b, python/typescript/javascript/go/java → qwen2.5-coder:7b.
